_comment: Locale heuristic for the explainer index. Each locale maps to a set of high-frequency stopwords; detect_lang() picks the locale with the most matches in a note's title+description. This is only a FALLBACK — a note's frontmatter `lang:` field always wins. To add a locale, add an entry here (framework default) or in local/explainers/locales.json (per-machine, merged over this). No code change needed.
